newsitem.title: USA: MOODY'S SAYS MAY CUT B.A.T INDUSTRIES PLC.
newsitem.headline: MOODY'S SAYS MAY CUT B.A.T INDUSTRIES PLC.

text.p: NEW YORK, July 23 - Moody's Investors Service is reviewing the A2 long-term and Prime-1 short-term ratings of BAT Industries plc, and the ratings of its insurance subsidiaries, for possible downgrade as a result of the company's agreement to acquire Cigarerra La Moderna (Cigarerra), Mexico's leading cigarette manufacturer, for approximately $1.7 billion. The review of BAT's ratings will focus on the level of financial flexibility the company will have subsequent to funding the Cigarerra transaction, and on BAT's resulting capacity to accommodate the financial and operating challenges that would be embodied in a U.S. tobacco litigation settlement.

The review of the life and non-life insurance operations will focus on the role of those businesses within BAT's global business strategy and on the degree to which they will support -- or enjoy support from -- the ultimate parent.

In addition, the review of the operating insurers within the Farmers Insurance Group, whose ratings outlooks are negative, will consider the nature and continuity of support available to those companies from Farmers Group, Inc., B.A.T's wholly owned USA-based insurance subsidiary, in the context of the overall quality of their business.
The following ratings are under review: BAT and supported subsidiaries:
BAT Industries plc: Loan stock rated A2 and counterparty rating of A2.
BAT Capital Corporation:Medium-term notes, euronotes, eurobonds, and notes rated A2, cunterparty rating of A2, and Prime-1 commercial paper rating based on a BAT guarantee.
BAT International Finance plc: Eurobonds rated A2 and Prime-1 commercial paper rating based on a BAT guarantee, and counterparty rating of Baa1.
BAT Finance BV: Loan stock rated A2 based on BAT guarantee.
Farmers Insurance Group: Farmers Group Capital I: Preferred stock rated "a2."
Farmers Group Capital II: Preferred stock rated "a2."
Farmers Insurance Exchange: Insurance financial strength rating of Aa3, and subordinated debt rated A2.
Farmers Insurance Company of Oregon: Insurance financial strength rating of Aa3.
Fire Insurance Exchange: Insurance financial strength rating of Aa3.
Truck Insurance Exchange: Insurance financial strength rating of Aa3.
Farmers New World Life Insurance Company: Insurance financial strength rating of Aa3.
Eagle Star Group: Eagle Star Insurance Co. Ltd.: Insurance financial strength rating of A3.
Eagle Star Life Assurance Company: Insurance financial strength rating of A3.

BAT has remained weak in the A2 rating category due to the potential need for capital contributions to its large financial services subsidiaries, the event-risk associated with a possible demerger of its tobacco and financial services operations, its high dividend payout, and U.S. tobacco litigation.
Although the Cigarerra acquisition will enhance the geographic diversity of BAT's tobacco operations, funding the $1.7 billion transaction will further strain its debt protection measures.
This transaction will also lessen the company's ability to maintain adequate levels of financial flexibility under a U.S. tobacco litigation settlement.
On June 16, Moody's confirmed BAT's rating following the announcement of a proposed settlement between U.S. tobacco companies an various states attorneys general.

The confirmation reflected our expectation that BAT had a variety of options available to help moderate the erosion in debt protection measures that would result from a settlement, and that the erosion which might occur would be offset by a material degree of insulation from litigation risks.
The Cigarerra will lessen BAT's options under a settlement scenario.
BAT Industries plc is a leading tobacco products and consumer financial services company headquartered in London.
Major financial services subsidiaries include Farmers Group, headquartered in California, and Eagle Star Life and General, headquartered in London. Wednesday, 23 July 1997 19:12:34 ENDS nN23214896
